items.title: Eiji Kitamura interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 13, 1999
items.q: this year I brought Eiji Hanaoka, he used to be my student, a very good student, and he plays the clarinet very good

ctx.x: When you get together, the group, to play tonight for instance, is there ever any trouble deciding what tunes to play? Or do the people you play with they know everything?

Uh huh. And then I do the program and — this year I brought Eiji Hanaoka, he used to be my student, a very good student, and he plays the clarinet very good, very good clarinet. I want to introduce him to United States jazz fans.
So you’ll be doing some double clarinet with your student?
